note: Only significant reusable / structurally-important UI components are listed. Section components (Hero, About, Services, Methodology, ProductStage, Market, Contact) are represented as screens rather than components. Small one-off SVG icons and the lucide-react icon library are excluded.

components.name: Navbar
components.note: Fixed top navigation with scroll-reactive styling, in-page anchor links, primary CTAs, and a responsive mobile/tablet overlay menu.

components.name: Footer
components.note: Site footer: brand blurb, social/contact links, quick-nav columns, and a newsletter email input (input has no submit handler — non-functional UI).

components.name: LoadingScreen
components.note: Full-screen branded loading overlay gated on asset readiness + minimum display time, with sequential logo-then-background fade-out and body-scroll lock.

components.name: SEO
components.note: Reusable document-head component (react-helmet-async) emitting title/description/keywords + Open Graph + Twitter card tags, all overridable via props.

components.name: ErrorBoundary
components.note: Top-level React error boundary (wraps App in main.tsx) rendering a branded recovery fallback and a reload action.

components.name: GlassCard
components.note: Generic glassmorphism card wrapper (dna-glass-card). Defined in src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx but NOT imported anywhere in the codebase — appears to be dead/unused code; flagged for human confirmation on whether to keep or remove.

components.name: ProductCard
components.note: Domain component inside ProductStage that renders a single product from its typed block model (heading/text/list/media/button) in an alternating split layout; resolves list-item icons by name from an icon map.
